# Learned suffix-table vertical-shift sensitivity

Author: @radialmonster
Verified by: @radialmonster
Lead: #803
Variant: unassigned
Builds on: #155, #351, 2026-11-04--radialmonster--suffix-luma-table-weak-transfer

## Claim

The fixed #155 table's declared alignment ranks 2/46 on public 1997 and 1998, so neither meets the unique-positive-maximum criterion. Fresh post-lead runs reproduce these results; predeclared 1993 ranks 5/46, while High Res 1994 meets the predeclared score requirement at 1/23. The shift families differ in size. The 1994 result is a necessary condition on its coarse grid, not physical registration or a codec.

## Original evidence

Lead #803 trained on public CC0 1995 and tested 1997 and 1998 using `tools/suffix_table_shift_probe.py` at commit `027ee79787ba02c95011338bfedbf6db7cc960c7`. Best shifts are 45 and 1, respectively: opposite adjacent cyclic shifts do not establish physical displacement. The #155 horizontal within-row transfer is a separate finding.

- Train 1995, `Olympus - E-M1MarkII - 16bit (4:3).ORI`, SHA-256 `8af918366ed969c6dddf5a48b8810fec1024858d22c75c5f1ac1a5c750a57a1f`.

- 1998 `Olympus - E-M1MarkII - 16bit (4:3).ORF`, SHA-256 `4bc52d99e4fbf2f09335a3301a4634bc261a98441edb824434ec069f7026cd71`.

Targets share the prefix `Olympus - E-M1MarkII - 16bit (4:3)`. The 32 binary64 big-endian table weights hash to `c7162dbb1376e8f8799dc717f3e93a51f65a38dbd80ca80065f2fbee402bda5f`; original result objects and table hash match discovery exactly. A separately written reference matched all 161 scores within 1e-12 and all ranks, ties and metadata exactly; it shares legacy token/preview extraction and the human account. Producer and reference exited zero with empty stderr; runtimes were about 30.15 and 30.87 seconds.

The 32-bin suffix table is fit on even preview rows of 1995 without intercept, lam=1 and smooth=10; q>=17 suffixes are retained without extra escape skipping. The preview target is centered within rows and predictions globally. Shift k compares Y[r,c] to P[(r+k)%nd,c]; a shared denominator and 1e-12 absolute tolerance define ranks and ties. The condition passes only if all scores are defined, r(0)>0 and r(0)>every other score+1e-12. Circular wrap, reused scenes and the rendered preview limit interpretation. No physical rows, sensor values, codec or calibrated significance follows.

## Reproduce

After reading the tool and imports and matching retained CC0 identities and local hashes, run at the named commit with an external hard 180-second phase limit, retaining stdout, stderr, errors and timeout:

    python -I -B tools/suffix_table_shift_probe.py --phase verification --train PATH1995 --sample 1997 PATH1997 --sample 1998 PATH1998 --sample 1993 PATH1993 --sample 1994 PATH1994

The tool hashes files before and after separate legacy reads; this is not an atomic snapshot. Timeout or incomplete input is unknown.
